text:
॥ Om, from the instruction regarding the nature of the inner (entity). ॥ 1/1/20 ॥

It has been stated as “invisible and non-soul.” And that invisibility is indicated by the statement: “The doer who has entered within, whom the moon and the mind traverse within, the gods do not know, though they dwell with Him.” This is said of one who is within. However, another is perceived through statements such as “Indra is the king” and “seven yoke Him.” Therefore, it should not be thought that He is the same as the Blissful One (Anandamaya). This is because of the instruction regarding the nature of the inner (entity). The Vishnu who is heard of as being within is the one referred to. This is due to the instruction regarding His nature, as in: “Within the ocean, whom the mind traverses, Brahma found the ten-sacrificer in the waters,” “Within the ocean, the sages behold, seeking the abode of the Marichis, the wise ones,” and “Of whom they call the egg-shell the radiance.” For He is the one who lies in the Ocean of Milk. And His potency is the egg-shell. As stated in the Vyasa Smriti: “Meditating on His own body, He desired to create various beings. In the beginning, He created them from His own essence and poured out His potency. That became the golden egg, with a thousand rays of equal brilliance. From it, Brahma, the father of all worlds, was born spontaneously. The waters are called Naras, and the sons of Man are the waters. Their path was previously known; by Him, Narayana is remembered.” And in the Chaturveda Shikha: “I am that radiance, the ray of Narayana, the Person born in the beginning. From the Person, Nature and the cosmic egg.” ॥ 20 ॥
